name: Admin Dashboard
summary: Full admin dashboard combining SidebarProvider with Sidebar navigation (Dashboard, Users, Orders, Analytics, Settings) and SidebarInset for main content. Features a KPI row with 4 Cards showing metric values, trends with TrendingUp/TrendingDown icons, and descriptive Icons. Charts row includes a LineChart showing revenue vs expenses over 12 months and a PieChart displaying user distribution by plan (Free, Starter, Pro, Enterprise). Users table built with Table components showing Avatar, name, email, role Badge, status Badge, and an actions DropdownMenu with View/Edit/Remove options. Quick actions Sheet slides from right showing recent platform activity with typed icons. Uses Tooltip on action buttons, useModel for users data, useCurrentUser for logged-in admin info, useNavigation for sidebar page switching, useTheme for chart color awareness, and toast on user actions.
shortSummary: Admin dashboard with sidebar navigation, KPI cards, revenue/pie charts, users table, and activity sheet
